expectations.text: Explains the pgvector similarity search mechanism
expectations.evidence: Section '4. Database Similarity Search': 'cosine similarity as 1 - (d.embedding <=> query_embedding) — the <=> operator is pgvector's cosine distance, so subtracting from 1 converts distance to similarity'

Section '2. Configuration Read': 'RAG_MATCH_COUNT — parsed as integer... controls how many documents to return' and 'RAG_MATCH_THRESHOLD — parsed as float... controls the minimum similarity score'. Also in Configuration section with defaults.
